statements.impact_statement: Not in use by application. Project-owner assertion for the service-minimal plain nginx PoC: the application does not invoke curl or use libcurl. This assertion is limited to the listed Debian package versions in this repository; it is not an independent runtime reachability verification. Reassess before adding application code, custom entrypoint scripts, health checks, modules, or configuration that uses curl/libcurl.
